surface-first.title: Surface first
surface-first.script: We are still at the surface, so before we ask when to write a skill, let's see what a skill is made of. I'll use the words your chat app uses, and if you work with a coding agent, some Slides have a second view that shows you the files behind each part.

the-mechanics-plainly.title: The mechanics, plainly
the-mechanics-plainly.script: I want to be exact about how a skill gets loaded, because everything later depends on it. So I say first what the AI really does, and use the dive only to make it easier to picture.
